about: What backs each claim. This project makes no historical or empirical claims: every statement in the map is about arithmetic, and each one is checked by a test you can run (npm test).

sources.title: Definition check: points inside stay bounded, points outside escape
sources.supports: 0, −1 and i keep the orbit of 0 bounded; 1 and 0.5 send it to infinity.

sources.title: Seahorse Valley location check
sources.supports: The Seahorse point lies outside the main cardioid and outside the period-2 disc, in the neck between them.

sources.title: Nucleus check: z returns to 0 after exactly the stated period
sources.supports: Each stage with a period is (to double precision) the centre of a copy of the set with that period, and not of any shorter one.

sources.title: Period-3 nucleus check
sources.supports: The real root of c³ + 2c² + c + 1 = 0 sends 0 back to 0 in three steps.

sources.title: Magnification check
sources.supports: Each stage's stated magnification matches its span, and the deepest stays within double precision.
